rationale: fc2_min_width 14 A is a phononDB heuristic never converged here, and it alone pushes 58 of 118 L1 structures past 399 atoms (FC3 max 384). Scan 10/12/14 A on diamond, c-BN, BAs and a 504-atom BC2N to decide whether later rounds can use a smaller FC2 cell. User chose this 11-13.
